Class NotificationInboxService

java.lang.Object
com.owltask.alerting.service.NotificationInboxService
public class NotificationInboxService extends Object
Internal class grouping the notification-inbox use cases: UC-17 (preferences), UC-18 (view), UC-19 (dismiss/mark read). Also records events pushed by AlertBroadcastManagerImpl so they show up in the inbox.
